description.zh: 对象ID，例如表ID，数据源ID，指标ID等
description.en: The object ID, such as a table ID, datasource ID, or metric ID.

description.zh: 监控对象类型：TABLE Dataphin表，DATASOURCE_TABLE 全域表，DATASOURCE 数据源,INDEX 指标，REALTIME_LOGICAL_TABLE 实时元表
description.en:
The monitored object type. Valid values:
- TABLE: Dataphin table.
- DATASOURCE_TABLE: global table.
- DATASOURCE: datasource.
- INDEX: metric.
- REALTIME_LOGICAL_TABLE: real-time meta table.

title.zh: 通过监控对象原始ID获取监控对象记录
title.en: Retrieve a quality watchtask record by monitored object original ID
